title: The Ransom Note
text: A note is pinned to a tree with a knife: the Lost are held, and the price is gold, to be left at the hollow oak by nightfall. A lock of hair is tied to it with string. You know whose it is.

options.label: Pay the ransom at the hollow oak, and pray they keep their word.

outcomes.text: The gold is taken. A path appears, marked in chalk on the trees.
The gold is taken, and nothing else happens at all.

options.label: The craftiest lies in wait at the oak to catch whoever comes for the gold.

outcomes.text: The kidnappers come for their gold and find you instead.

options.label: Tear it down and keep looking; you will not be bled by thieves.

outcomes.text: Whoever wrote it is watching now. You can feel where from.
